answer:
Promptfoo 0.124.0 added support for comma-separated values in `--filter-metadata`, where the commas act as OR separators.

The changelog says: "support comma-separated OR values in --filter-metadata" [promptfoo/0.124.0.md].

The command-line docs describe how it works: "Filter tests by metadata substring. Commas separate OR values (`\,` is a comma); repeated flags use AND." [promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md]

In practice, a single key can take several comma-separated values, and a test matches if it matches any of them. To match a literal comma, escape it as `\,`. Repeated `--filter-metadata` flags are still combined with AND logic.

The reference page still says only "Multiple filters are combined with AND logic" [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/reference.md], without mentioning the comma syntax.
